metadata.title: Some results on weighted p-harmonic $\ell$-forms on weighted manifolds
metadata.abstract: Basing on new curvature conditions for the Bochner technique of Petersen-Wrink in \cite{PW21}, in this paper, we give some vanishing properties for weighted $L^Q$ $p$-harmonic $\ell$-forms on weighted manifolds, where $p>1, Q>p-1.$ These results generalize some previous theorems for $L^Q$ harmonic $\ell$-forms of Dung-Dung-Hung on the paper \cite{DDH25}.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 加权 p-调和形式消失
analysis.workSummary: 利用 Petersen–Wrink 型曲率条件的 Bochner 技术，证明加权流形上 L^Q 的 p-调和 ℓ-形式消失性质。
analysis.breakthrough: 将已有调和形式消失结论推进到非线性及加权范围。
analysis.limitations: p>1、Q>p−1，并须满足正文所列曲率条件。
